text:
maria: Heads-up — AcmeCorp contract requires feature 'seat-usage-dashboard' to be toggled on for only their account starting tomorrow. Need ops to enable org-scoped flag with contract gating. Is it safe to do a 10% fractional canary first?
jon: What's the entitlement key? Is this per-seat or per-org? Last contract says entitlement_id=ACME-ENT-42
maria: entitlement_id=ACME-ENT-42, it's org-level (all seats). We want to mirror contract effective_date 2026-04-01. Also want auto-fallback to legacy path if errors >1%.
lee: @ops-oncall I can do the flag change once we confirm rollout policy. Proposed: percent=10 for 30m, then 50 for 2h, then 100. Rollback on error rate >0.5% or p99 +200ms.
ops-oncall: ok. Playbook? Also need acme allowed org id: org_78910. Will add to allowlist and create canary slice named acme-contract-4-1.
bhavik: quick CR — changes in toggles-service: add contract_key check to evaluation. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/toggles/pull/512 Please review.
sam: @lee @jon lgtm on rollout windows. Ops, make sure audit log and MFA step for permit change (per enterprise).
devops-bot: runbook created -> https://runbooks.internal/redwood/flags/entitlement-rollout. Command to enable: ```redwoodctl flags apply --org org_78910 --flag seat_usage_dashboard --state on --canary 10 --meta contract=ACME-ENT-42```
ops-oncall: executing now. Will post outputs.
ops-oncall: applied. Returned: success=1, errors=0, change_id=chg_x9a3. Canary slice: acme-contract-4-1. Start time: 2026-03-26T16:12Z
maria: :tada: Thx. Monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood/monitoring/flags/chg_x9a3 — watching for errors.
lee: started 30m synthetic tests against org_78910. If anything spikes, I'll flip kill-switch: ```redwoodctl flags set --change chg_x9a3 --state off```
ops-oncall: Metrics at +15m: error 0.02% (below 0.5%), p99 latency +20ms. Holding.
bhavik: I've merged the CR and will roll out the toggles-service patch to canary pool tomorrow 09:00 PT. Not blocking for now.
sam: small ask — include contract_id in audit events (so legal can trace). Can we add a note in PR?
jon: @bhavik please add audit field contract_id and maybe org_id. Thx.
maria: We'll close this thread once chg_x9a3 hits 100% or we roll back. Thanks all.
